profile.name: 束线狭缝
profile.description: 用于X射线束线中的机械狭缝装置，通过调节水平和垂直方向的开口宽度与中心位置来限定束斑尺寸、调整束流通过区域，并可在需要时关闭或完全阻挡光束。该类设备常用于束流整形、对准、光路管理和实验站前的束流控制。
profile.description_en: A mechanical slit device used on X-ray beamlines to define the beam aperture by adjusting the horizontal and vertical opening widths and center positions. It is used to shape the beam, control the transmitted region, align the beam path, and close or fully block the beam when needed for lightpath control and experiment setup.

registry.name: SLAC National Accelerator Lab Lusi Slits
registry.description: LUSI Beamline Slits是由SLAC National Accelerator Lab生产的表征设备，主要功能包括关闭、打开、状态查询、运动控制。
